class.description: DWA-based local planner for Ackermann/Tricycle (forklift) robots. Samples the physically reachable (v, delta) space respecting traction acceleration limits and steering slew-rate limits derived from the Kinco motor controller constants. Uses the tricycle kinematic model (omega = v * tan(delta) / L) for trajectory simulation. Supports rotate-in-place mode for large heading corrections.
